g.text: FPGA bank 13 connects by RGMII to U902, the DP83867IRRGZR PHY. Four MDI

g.desc: network protocols are implemented by the FPGA design and software.

g.desc: Y900 is a 25 MHz crystal with 22 pF capacitors. R906 is the 11 kohm bias

g.text: and C932 provide pull-up and filtering.

g.text: U900 forwards SCK, MOSI, CS_N and periodic HOST_ALIVE, powered by IO3V3.

g.desc: U900 forwards SCK, MOSI, CS_N and periodic HOST_ALIVE, powered by IO3V3.

g.text: HOST_ALIVE is now a pulse train, not a static ready flag; FPGA must track it.

g.desc: HOST_ALIVE is now a pulse train, not a static ready flag; FPGA must track it.

g.text: U901 returns MISO, FPGA_IRQ, FPGA_DONE and FPGA_INIT_N from SYS3V3.

g.desc: U901 returns MISO, FPGA_IRQ, FPGA_DONE and FPGA_INIT_N from SYS3V3.

g.text: Both use 74LVC125APW,118 with Ioff; C907 decouples U901.

g.desc: Both use 74LVC125APW,118 with Ioff; C907 decouples U901.

g.text: U901 3Y/4Y drive PC6/PC7; OE pins stay low, 100k define startup levels.

g.desc: U901 3Y/4Y drive PC6/PC7; OE pins stay low, 100k define startup levels.

g.text: U904 through U907 protect the four Ethernet pairs. Four 75 ohm resistors join

g.desc: U904 through U907 protect the four Ethernet pairs. Four 75 ohm resistors join
